title: Design System: Fluid Finance Public Editorial

motion.name: quote-tape
motion.purpose: Pause on hover, focus-within or explicit user control; disable for reduced motion.

shadows.name: more-menu
shadows.purpose: Existing Tailwind shadow-lg on desktop More overlay only.

components.name: Topic link
components.css: .ds-topic { display:inline-block; padding:14px 19px; font:700 13px Inter,Arial,sans-serif; color:rgb(var(--ink)); text-decoration:none; } .ds-topic:hover { color:rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:6px; } :focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Theme control
components.css: .ds-theme { width:40px; height:40px; border:1px solid var(--news-rule); border-radius:0; background:rgb(var(--canvas)); color:rgb(var(--ink)); font:16px Inter,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-theme:hover { background:var(--news-subtle); } :focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Story link
components.css: .ds-story { display:block; font:700 34px/1.08 Barlow,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:rgb(var(--ink)); text-decoration:none; } .ds-story:hover { text-decoration:underline; } :focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Editorial action
components.css: .ds-action { display:inline-flex; gap:8px; color:rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); font:700 12px Inter,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-action:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:4px; } :focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Latest item
components.html: Latest researchGhana markets in focus
components.css: .ds-latest { display:block; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--news-rule); color:rgb(var(--ink)); text-decoration:none; font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-latest span { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--news-muted); font-size:10px; } .ds-latest strong { font-size:14px; line-height:1.4; font-weight:600; } .ds-latest:hover strong { text-decoration:underline; } :focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(var(--cyan-ink)); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: A compact Ghanaian financial publication, following the user-selected Bloomberg-like editorial direction. Market data and research establish the hierarchy through large sans-serif headlines, disciplined columns and strong rules. White and neutral charcoal themes share one composition.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper, fine dividers and heavy section rules.
Fluid cyan actions and semantic market changes.
Equally supported light and dark themes.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Use the canvas and ink channels for ordinary surfaces and text so both themes remain coherent.

dos: Do preserve the supplied Fluid identity and existing company imagery.
Do use theme channels and signed market values.
Do maintain headline hierarchy, compact metadata and rule-separated columns.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, rounded marketing cards or unrelated imagery into this editorial surface.
Don't fabricate live quotes, research or timestamps when sources are unavailable.
